positions.name: MissingIdTestCaseSpec
positions.frame: what must the missing-id-derivation test case reproduce, and what must it guarantee about the system's behavior?
positions.why: src-1 states what the test reproduces (a known prod failure pattern: a ## heading with no id field) and src-2 states the required outcome (no crash, valid slug) — together they read as one test-case spec: the scenario paired with its pass/fail criteria. Directional observations flag a conviction gradient (src-1 reads as flat claim/description, src-2 as settled decision/requirement) and a temporal split (src-1 present/realis/concrete describing an existing artifact, src-2 future/irrealis/abstract projecting required behavior) — this is held as tension within the frame rather than resolved, since a spec naturally pairs a concrete reproduction with an abstract requirement on it.
